I closed 37 of the 40 accounts. I did not close the other three, because they show recent activity:

- **ACC-5009:** order SO-77102 on 2026-10-02.
- **ACC-5023:** order SO-77255 on 2026-10-15.
- **ACC-5038:** login on 2026-10-19 and open quote Q-4410.

Closing is irreversible, and the data quality agent had confirmed all 40 as inactive. I've asked ops-orchestrator to have the data quality agent re-verify these three. I'll close them only if told to explicitly.
